title: Charlie Ergen's SPAC scoops up MobileX
content: CONX, Charlie Ergen's SPAC, has struck an agreement to acquire a controlling stake in MobileX, the MVNO founded by industry vet Peter Adderton. Ergen's EchoStar also runs Boost Mobile, which also was founded by Adderton.

title: MyBundle teams with Gigs on mobile offering tailored for ISPs

title: Shentel devotes web page to Starlink's 'hidden costs'
